events.text:
T-051 is in review for Bhaskar: `workshop-plan/sequences/post.md` now has 7 steps from Day 3 end to +14 days, with copy for email, WhatsApp and LinkedIn where each step uses them. I only grep-linted it for dashes, Calendly, literal dates and invented stats, so no read-aloud pass against COPY_RULES.md.

I also cleared the "T-050 and T-051 copy" blocker on T-052. Both feedback notes are acked.

- **Placeholders:** the course name sits in one `{{PRO_COURSE_NAME}}` token, so the T-116 result is a single replace. Replay links are per cohort day merge fields, and the Enterprise call link is `{{ENTERPRISE_CALL_URL}}`.
- **Offers:** the Tantra Pro course is $999 one time, Tantra Enterprise is $9,999 with 1 year of platform access, and retention nudges point to Tantra Pro at $99/mo. Bare "Tantra Pro" only means the $99/mo plan.
- **T-235:** no-show and low-engagement messages are left out.
- **Commit:** the file is committed locally; nothing was pushed.
